summary: Evernote's main friction themes include pricing and monetization, app performance and usability, data ownership and security, and user experience with ads and notifications.

themes.name: User Experience and Migration
themes.description: Users are abandoning Evernote for alternatives due to poor UX, lack of features, and frustration with the app's direction, especially in mobile environments.
themes.recommendation: Focus on improving mobile UX, streamline onboarding, and enhance cross-platform consistency.

themes.name: Ads and Notifications
themes.description: Users find the ads intrusive, disruptive, and annoying, especially the full-screen video ads that interrupt note-taking workflows.
themes.recommendation: Reduce or eliminate ads, especially in the free version, and improve ad targeting.

themes.name: App Performance and Usability
themes.description: Users report that the app has become slower, less intuitive, and less feature-rich over time, with issues like non-functional predictive text and intrusive popups.
themes.recommendation: Invest in performance optimization, simplify UI, and improve feature reliability.

quotes.text: Used to be good. Now impossibly slow and with less features. And very intrusive.
Extreme downgrade in quality over years. Not only has this app turned into one giant self-advertisement, the free version is borderline useless.

New Owners Ruined It. The price was increased and they turned it from a notes app to an AI infused piece of junk. It takes 60 seconds to open on a modern and fast Mac. It pops up information all the time. It has features no notes app needs. Total Junk!

themes.name: Pricing and Monetization
themes.description: Users are frustrated with rapid price increases, forced upgrades, and the shift from a free to a paid model, which has led to dissatisfaction and migration to alternatives like Joplin, Obsidian, and UpNote.
themes.recommendation: Revisit pricing strategy, offer more flexible plans, and communicate value clearly.

themes.name: Data Ownership and Security
themes.description: Users are concerned about data being stored in the cloud and losing control over their information, with some citing past data loss incidents.
themes.recommendation: Offer self-hosting options or better data control features to address security concerns.

quotes.text: They will hold your data hostage.. So difficult to get your data out. I ultimately never did. Lost it.
